free_tier.stated: Reported as 'Completely free', no registration required, with unlimited API calls and no RSS feeds. The page shows a search form, a category tree and a donate prompt, and also Login and Add user links.
free_tier.notes: The third-party 'no registration' claim and the page's Login and Add user links were not reconciled; no search or download was run.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file, never the payload

retention.stated: A third-party listing claims 'Approximately 1,400 days of retention'.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the answer is an NZB pointer file.

interface_detail: Web search with a Spotnet-style category tree; a third-party listing says it provides an API with unlimited calls. The API path was not read.
tooling: Third-party listings call it Spotnet-based with an API; whether Prowlarr or NZBHydra2 can add it was not tested. The origin answered a direct request with a bot challenge (HTTP 403) and the page was readable only through a pinned reader.
chaining: A free fallback search for Dutch-oriented Spotnet releases when the paid indexers lack a name.

limits.value: reported: unlimited API calls; none published on the page read

binding_note: No numeric limit is named by any source read.

identity_cost.detail: Reported 'No registration required'; the page also exposes Login and Add user links, so whether a search or an NZB needs an account was not confirmed.

reliability_note: A direct request on the read date was answered with a bot challenge (HTTP 403); a third-party listing reports 98% uptime.
confidence_note: The free, unlimited and no-registration claims are third-party; the page text shows the Login and Add user links. Nothing was exercised.
